app.name: VideoStudio
app.tagline: Finished short videos from a voice note

landing.heroTitle: Turn a voice note into a finished, edited short video
landing.heroText: Upload a voice note, a talking-head video or a script. Pick a template, language and size. Get back animated scenes synced to every word, captions, sound effects, music and a mastered mix. Any language, any aspect ratio.
landing.freeNote: 2 free videos a month, 720p with a watermark. No card needed.
landing.step1Text: A voice note, a camera video or a script. Add photos and clips if you have them.
landing.step2Text: The AI writes the storyboard. You check the preview, fix any text and place your images.
landing.step3Text: Download a mastered MP4 with captions, sound effects and music.
landing.galleryText: Six are open to everyone today; the rest unlock on paid plans as we polish them.

templates.requestText: Tell us what the video should look like. A link to an example helps.
templates.requestThanks: Thanks! We log every request and build the most wanted ones first.

auth.forgotText: We will email you a link if the address exists.
auth.forgotSent: Check your inbox for the reset link.
auth.resetDone: Password updated. Sign in with the new one.
auth.verifyFailed: This link is invalid or expired.
auth.verifyBanner: Please verify your email. We sent a link to {email}.

wizard.title: New video
wizard.sourceUploadHint: Voice note or camera video, up to 200 MB and 10 minutes.
wizard.sourceScriptHint: We generate the voice for you.
wizard.dropHere: Drop a file here or click to choose
wizard.tooLong: This recording is {duration} long; the limit is 10 minutes.
wizard.tooLarge: This file is larger than 200 MB.
wizard.badType: Upload an audio or video file.
wizard.scriptHint: 30–60 seconds reads best: one idea per sentence.
wizard.assetsHint: Up to 20 files: JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, MP4, MOV. Describe each one in a few words so the AI places it where you talk about it.
wizard.assetsAfterCreate: Files upload right after the project is created.
wizard.keyPointsHint: One per line. The AI will not invent facts, so tell it what matters.
wizard.requiredSource: Add a recording or a script first.

project.previewHint: One frame per scene. Check the texts and where your images go, then render.
project.noPreviewYet: The preview appears here when the storyboard is ready.
project.deleteConfirm: Delete this video and its files?
project.textsHint: Edit the words that appear on screen. Captions follow your voice automatically.
project.assetsHint: Where each file appears. Swap, remove, or insert an unused file as a full-screen shot.
project.watermarkNote: Free plan: 720p with a watermark. Upgrade for full resolution without watermark.
project.invalidAsset: This file could not be read and was skipped.

billing.title: Plan and credits
billing.renews: Credits renew with each successful payment; unused credits do not roll over.
billing.mockText: Payments run in test mode. Confirm to switch to the {plan} plan instantly.
billing.creditRule: 1 credit = one rendered video up to 90 seconds; longer videos use 1 credit per started 90 seconds.

settings.title: Settings
settings.brandKitHint: Your palette and display font are applied to every template. Available on Pro and Agency.
settings.deleteText: This removes your videos and files. Type your password to confirm.

pricing.title: Simple pricing
pricing.text: Start free. Upgrade when you need more videos, higher resolution or no watermark.
